sections.title: Right now
lines: Pre-race growth, green flag Sat 4:00pm CT. Sold 0, 0 resting. Worst line $0.

sections.title: Next wave of contracts
lines: A driver gets a new wave when 90% of what he offered has sold.

sections.title: Tightening
lines: Backstop off. It stops a driver whose line falls under -$250.
Glide starts Sat 12:00pm CT: limit slides from -$250 to +$100 by Sat 4:00pm CT.
Under the limit it trims rows, buys back cheaply, and sells to close gaps from Sat 2:30pm CT.
Even-up from Sat 4:00pm CT, last-resort take from Sat 3:40pm CT, green flag Sat 4:00pm CT.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
lines: Mostly yes: waves, price steps and the glide run by rule. The worst line may not fully close.
